description: Reuse sanitized security evidence only while every scanner-specific correctness input remains unchanged, and coordinate scanner misses through shared resource limits.

requirements.title: Correctness-keyed sanitized scanner evidence
requirements.description: When scanner inputs, tool identity, normalization policy identity, and advisory freshness are unchanged, security-health shall reuse sanitized typed findings; when a represented input changes, security-health shall rerun only the affected scanner and replace its cached findings.

validation.notes: Proves cold/warm finding equivalence, zero warm scanner calls, and affected-scanner-only invalidation.
Proves relevant source, scanner tool, and advisory-day changes invalidate while generated dependency content does not.
Proves persistence uses an explicit normalized-field allowlist and excludes scanner-native secret material.

requirements.title: Shared scanner admission and request coalescing
requirements.description: When concurrent validation requests need the same scanner key, security-health shall execute that work once and share its typed result; when distinct cache misses execute, security-health shall admit them through one bounded weighted resource budget.

validation.notes: Concurrent requests for one scanner key invoke the command once and receive equivalent results.
Concurrent distinct misses never exceed the configured scanner-class admission limit.
Canceled and malformed scanner executions are not persisted as reusable security verdicts.

requirements.title: Scanner-level performance evidence
requirements.description: When an applicable scanner is evaluated, security-health shall emit a scanner child stage containing availability, fingerprint time, cache outcome, coalescing, admission wait, execution time, finding count, and resource measurements.

validation.notes: Validation metrics contain one child stage per applicable scanner with cache and execution gauges.
